summary:
Today’s posts center on AI infrastructure, developer tooling, and the reliability of AI-powered experiences. Microsoft highlighted **Visual Studio Code 1.148** with the latest editor updates, GitHub’s **“Art of play in the age of AI”** on how AI is reshaping creativity and software building, and an **Azure Compute Ignite 2026** preview emphasizing the infrastructure layer powering the next wave of AI, including the compute foundation needed for advanced workloads.

Another key theme was improving AI quality and trustworthiness: **“Measuring Freshness for Web Grounding”** focused on evaluating how up-to-date web-grounded AI responses are, pointing to better techniques for retrieval and grounding accuracy in AI systems. Overall, the day’s announcements tie together the stack from **developer tools (VS Code)** to **AI infrastructure on Azure** to **evaluation methods for grounded AI applications**.
